profile.headline: Software Engineer | US Army Veteran | Outdoorsman
profile.summary:
I am a creative, driven, and passionate individual in the fields of software development, freight technology, business development, and leadership. A veteran of the U.S. Army, I proudly served in one combat deployment to Afghanistan as an Infantry Team-Leader.

My educational career began at Spokane Falls Community College, where I earned an Associate’s degree, followed by a Bachelor’s degree in Organizational Management and an MBA in Project Management from Ashford University. Certifications include Hack Reactor's (575+ hr) Advanced Software Engineering Immersive program and Scrum Alliance Certified Scrum Master (CSM). I continue my formal education at Arizona State University, where I am pursuing a second undergraduate degree in Software Engineering.

My drive and ambition combined, make me an ideal candidate for bringing project concepts and business ideas to life.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architect solutions for front-end feature implementations. 
- Break down projects into small deliverable tasks and provide accurate delivery timeframe.
- Implement features & solutions that require both backend and frontend work.
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · GraphQL · Databases · Material-UI · Technical Architecture · Code Review · JavaScript · Communication · React.js · Jest

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
- Created a library of common UI components to efficiently be reused throughout applications. 
- Utilized Storybook tool to easily display components to stakeholders, product owners, and designers.    
- Documented component functionality and purpose for reusability throughout company.  
- Problem solved through component manipulation when Material UI components did not meet our needs.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative software solutions to transform service performance, durability, cost, and security.
- Implemented efficient and reusable front-end systems and components to streamline usability.
- Mentor, teach, and coach junior engineers to build team cohesion
- Collaborate with team in an Scrum Agile work setting
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · GraphQL · Databases · NoSQL · RxJS · Code Review · Communication · Jest

positions.title: Business Owner
positions.description:
- Build relationships with key customers and ensure Logistics is consistently meeting or exceeding goals.
- Develop and implement strategies to drive the company into new markets by building strong 
relationships with carrier companies. 
- Manage all aspects of logistics planning for clients.

positions.title: Owner Operator Driver Manager and Planner
positions.description:
- Responsible for a fleet of 30-35 driving associates. 
- Coordinated 50+ daily export plans in the Arizona, New Mexico, and Eastern Texas markets. Provided business guidance to 15 Owner Operator driving associates. 
- Develop amicable relationships with customers to grow and develop business in my market.

positions.title: Restaurant Manager
positions.description:
- Performed primary restaurant operation functions: planning, training, organizing, scheduling, staffing, leading, disciplining, and controlling. 
- Established effective sales projections and inventory tracking systems to decrease weekly total loss by an average of 15%. 
- Developed sales promotions and social media marketing campaigns increasing sales by 10%.

positions.title: Infantry Team Leader
positions.description:
- Responsible for welfare, training, fitness, morale, and discipline of a 4 to 8-soldier fire-team.
- Successfully maintained 100% accountability of soldiers and equipment during 3 combat training rotations and one 10-month combat deployment.

positions.title: Assistant General Manger
positions.description: Supervised food quality and availability met restaurant standards. Successfully increased restaurants customer satisfaction, sales, and loyalty. Directed employees to maximize overall restaurant productivity.
